description: An aggregated representation of a transmission interchange between two regions. Capacity is added in discrete units of `unit_size`, priced by a capital cost curve, and derated by a proportional line loss.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`).

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type to be used in PCM modeling.

capacity_limits.description: Allowable capacity for a transmission line. Units: MW.

capital_costs.description: Cost of adding new capacity to the nodal transmission line. Units: USD/MW.

line_loss.description: Transmission loss for each transport technology. Units: 1.

unit_size.description: Used for integer investment decisions. Represents the rating capacity of individual new lines. Units: MW.

requirements.description: List of requirement IDs associated with the component.

financial_data.description: Struct containing relevant financial information for a technology.

title: AggregateTransportTechnology
